This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Distinguish between real and imaginary conditions.
  • Talk about unlikely or impossible situations in the present or future.
  • Talk about two actions together.
  • Practice words like tests and tasks.
  • Talk about science, exploration, beliefs and opinions.
